aliasing.boundary: deterministic signals alias too; reconstruction requires spectral assumptions; post-sampling filter cannot generally distinguish identical sample sequences

nyquist_boundary.strictGuarantee: fs>2B for arbitrary strictly bandlimited signal under ideal infinite-sample reconstruction assumptions
nyquist_boundary.boundary: fs/2 frequency vs 2B required sampling rate; equality needs endpoint restrictions, not arbitrary phase guarantee

sample_hold.boundary: continuous plant exists between samples; sequence is not impulse train; hold is distinct from sampling and quantization

sample_rate_design.boundary: same one-sample delay gives different physical phase lag; rate selection must consider dynamics, processing delay and bandwidth, not Nyquist threshold alone

prefilter.boundary: finite-order filter attenuates rather than eliminates out-of-band components; affects desired band too; located before sampling

ideal_sampler.spectrumConvention: angular frequency transform; X_s(jw)=1/T sum_m X(j(w-m ws)); ws=2pi/T
ideal_sampler.boundary: Dirac impulses have weights not ordinary finite amplitudes; ideal sampler is mathematical abstraction, not finite-width pulse or zero-order hold

sampled_feedback.hold: zero order, immediate update without computational delay
sampled_feedback.boundary: different delay/hold requires a different recurrence
